# Exact mate fixture

Generated by the application-loop `mate-coincident.json` scenario using the pre-B5
executable available at task start. The task checkout was
`d57a2f163e39bb25ee2fdad400759adc88604eb7`. The two parts match
the assembly's accepted pins.

For 0.4.0, `soliddraft asm rebuild rig.dwasm --json` re-saved the assembly.
Only `manifest.json.writer` changed from `soliddraft 0.1.0` to `soliddraft 0.4.0`.
All other entry bytes, source pins, timestamps and compression settings stayed unchanged.
Keep the binary files as generated.

The regression test opens, proves, updates and saves the assembly, then compares the
entire saved archive with the fixture. Bounded-mate support must add no fields or
change any placements in this exact case.
